items.label: Nantong Jianghai IR activity record: 2026 (04-29-2026)
items.signal_prefix: Management (IR record): supercapacitors are already benefiting deeply

set.signal: Management (IR record): supercapacitors are already benefiting deeply from server UPS and data-center power-supply upgrades - both EDLC and LIC products have gone through trials, certification and batch trial runs with global power-supply customers; in this server UPS / data-center business it has already achieved revenue at the tens-of-millions-of-RMB level in 2026 and is striving for annual revenue above RMB 1.5 hundred million (the target is for this business, not total supercapacitor revenue, which the same record puts at RMB 3.52 hundred million for 2025). It has begun line automation and capacity expansion and is working on customer technical support, key-material supply and cost reduction.
set.figure: target: server UPS / data-center supercapacitor revenue above RMB 1.5 hundred million a year (2026 so far at the tens-of-millions-of-RMB level)

items.reason: The RMB 1.5 hundred million target and the tens-of-millions 2026 revenue refer to the server UPS / data-center supercapacitor business the answer is about; total supercapacitor revenue was already RMB 3.52 hundred million in 2025 (same record) and RMB 249.32 million in H1 2026, so the entry as written reads like a total-supercapacitor target.
items.evidence: 超级电容已深度受益于服务器UPS、数据中心供电升级趋势……2026年已取得千万级营收……力争年营收1.5亿元以上 / 超级电容营业收入3.52亿元，同比增长52.51%

items.label: Nantong Jianghai half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-21-2026)
items.signal_prefix: Construction in progress RMB 134.96 million at June 30, 2026

set.signal: Construction in progress RMB 134.96 million at June 30, 2026 (RMB 82.31 million at end-2025), including the supercapacitor production line (RMB 29.04 million) and the formed-foil production line (RMB 18.39 million). Project progress: formed-foil production line 93.92%, Inner Mongolia Haili phase II 90.00%, Inner Mongolia Haili phase III basically completed. Cash paid for fixed and other long-term assets RMB 87.01 million in H1 2026 (RMB 68.26 million a year earlier).

items.reason: 'Investment in the period RMB 87.01 million, up 256.48% YoY' mixes bases: the 87.01 million is the H1 capex cash outflow, whose year-earlier figure in the cash-flow statement is RMB 68.26 million (about +27%); the 256.48% comes from the investment-status table's RMB 24.41 million comparator, so as a capex growth rate it overstates.
